title: `broadcast_in_dim` cannot be transposed for non-increasing `broadcast_dimensions`
description: Its shape rule only rejects duplicates, and its docstring shows `broadcast_dimensions=(1, 0)` as an implicit transpose.
The primal and forward mode handle this correctly if the result shape differs from the operand shape.
Reverse mode raises a `ValueError`, because the cotangent has the wrong shape.
`_broadcast_in_dim_transpose_rule` sums the cotangent over the axes that are not in `broadcast_dimensions`
and puts back the axes of size 1 with `expand_dims`.
`reduce_sum` keeps the remaining axes in the order of the result.
The operand has them in the order given by `broadcast_dimensions`.
The two orders agree only if `broadcast_dimensions` is increasing, and the rule never permutes the axes back.
If the result shape equals the operand shape, the primal is already wrong, see `broadcast-in-dim-forwarding`.
reproducer: # The primal and forward mode are correct.
# Reverse mode raises, because the cotangent has the shape of the result.
# actual:  ValueError: Expected cotangent type float32[3,2] but got float32[2,3]
